y-m-22-07.goal: Qaphela ukuba kwi-histogram apho umgca othe nkqo ungaqali ku-0 irhasho yokuphakama kweebha yahlukile kwirhasho yamanani aphindaphindekayo, uthathe isigqibo ngomahluko kumanani aphindaphindekayo okwenyani, uze uphinde uyibhale njengesaziso esingabangeli ukungaqondani.
y-m-22-07.material:
I-histogram yashicilelwa kwisaziso selayibrari. Yahlula abafundi abali-142 baba ziiklasi ezintathu ngenani leencwadi eziboleke ngenyanga.
[I-histogram echazwe ngamazwi] Umgca othe tye ubonisa '0 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye ngaphantsi kweencwadi ezi-5', '5 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye ngaphantsi kweencwadi ezili-10', kunye '10 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye ngaphantsi kweencwadi ezili-15'. Umgca othe nkqo yinani labafundi, ngeempawu ukusuka ezantsi ukuya phezulu kwi-40, 44, 48, 52 abafundi. Ngaphantsi kwempawu ye-40 ayizotywanga emfanekisweni. Amanani okwenyani aphindaphindekayo eebha ezintathu ngabafundi aba-46, 52, 44 ngokulandelelana.
Indlela yesaziso: "Abafundi abaninzi kakhulu baboleke iincwadi ezi-5 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye ngaphantsi kweencwadi ezili-10! Malunga namaxesha amabini ezinye iiklasi."

y-m-22-01.goal: Qinisekisa ukuba ukulungiselela idatha efanayo ngokutshintsha ububanzi bodidi kuphela kunokwenza ukuba imilo yokwabiwa ibonakale yahlukile, uze uthi yeyiphi inxalenye yesigwebo sakho sokuqala ekufuneka uyigcine neyiphi ekufuneka uyilungise xa kufika itheyibhile entsha nolwazi olutsha. Khetha ububanzi bodidi lwentetho, unezizathu.
y-m-22-01.material: Abafundi abangama-24 kwiklasi bathathe uvavanyo lwamagama (kwi-100, amanqaku ngamanani aphelele). Utitshala ufuna ukulungiselela amanqaku afanayo etshintsha ububanzi bodidi kuphela. Zonke iididi zifundwa 'ubuncinane ○ amanqaku kwaye ngaphantsi kwe-○ amanqaku' (umzekelo, 'amanqaku angama-60 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye angaphantsi kwama-80' ayabandakanya ama-60 kwaye awabandakanyi ama-80). Akukho magama omntu ngamnye asetyenzisiweyo. Elona nqaku liphezulu li-98 kwaye elona liphantsi li-47.

y-m-22-06.title: Iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokwahlula iirekhodi zokutsiba intambo zibe ziiklasi ezintlanu
y-m-22-06.topic: Ukwenza itafile yamaxesha: ukukhetha ixabiso lokuqala nobungakanani beeklasi ukuze zihambelane neemeko
y-m-22-06.goal: Khetha ixabiso lokuqala nobungakanani beeklasi ngeendlela ezininzi phantsi kweemeko zokuba zonke iirekhodi ziyahlangabezana, akukho klasi ingenanto, akukho klasi ithwalwe ngokugqithisileyo; phatha umda ('ngaphantsi') ngokufanelekileyo; uze uthelekise indlela ukusabalalisa kubonakala ngayo ngokwahlukileyo ngokuxhomekeke kuyilo.
y-m-22-06.material:
Amanani okutsiba intambo (amaxesha, amanani aphelele) abafundi abali-16 abawenzileyo kumzuzu o-1, ebhalwe ukusuka kwelona lincinci, ngala alandelayo.
8, 12, 15, 17, 18, 21, 22, 23, 25, 26, 28, 31, 34, 37, 41, 55
Ezi rekhodi zihlelwe etafileni yamaxesha. Kukho iiklasi ezintlanu, zonke zibungakanani obufanayo, zibhalwe 'ubuncinane ○ amaxesha nangaphantsi kwamaxesha ○'. Iklasi yokuqala iqala kwi-a amaxesha okanye ngaphezulu yaye ububanzi beklasi bungamaxesha ayi-w (a linani lemvelo elingu-0 okanye ngaphezulu, w linani lemvelo elingu-1 okanye ngaphezulu). Oko kukuthi, iiklasi ziyalandelelana: a okanye ngaphezulu nangaphantsi kwe-a+w, a+w okanye ngaphezulu nangaphantsi kwe-a+2w, … Iimeko ezilandelayo kufuneka zigcinwe. ① Iirekhodi zabafundi bonke abali-16 ziwela ngaphakathi kweeklasi ezintlanu ② Akukho klasi ingenanto ③ Akukho klasi enabafundi abangaphezulu kwabasi-8 (isiqingatha sesixa sonke).
